page.title: Agentpost — A different email address for every site
page.description: Create a separate email alias for every signup, read incoming mail with your agent, and disable unwanted addresses. Open source, on your own domain and Cloudflare account.
nav.label: Main navigation
hero.title: A different email address.
hero.description: Keep your personal email out of signups. Let your agent create a fresh alias, read the mail, and help you switch it off when you no longer need it.
hero.note: Your domain. Your Cloudflare account. Managed through CLI, MCP, or API.
workflow.title: Sign up. Read the mail. Stay in control.
workflow.label: Email workflow steps
workflow.caption: Choose a step to explore this sample signup. No real email is sent. Creating and disabling addresses require administrator access; OAuth agents can create their own inboxes.
create.title: Create a fresh alias
create.description: Three random English words. Use a different address for each site.
receive.title: Read the signup email
receive.description: Your agent fetches the message from that site’s own inbox.
demo.title: Agent inbox
demo.named: Random by default · Custom names supported
demo.subject: Welcome to your new account
demo.body: Thanks for signing up. Your account confirmation is ready to review.
capabilities.eyebrow: Email aliases your agent can manage
capabilities.title: Share an alias. Keep your personal address.
capabilities.description: Separate signups, receipts, and newsletters without handing every site the same email address.
feature1.title: A fresh address for each signup.
feature1.description: Let the server generate a three-word address, or choose a name. Add a private label so your agent knows which site it belongs to.
feature2.title: Read, send, and reply.
feature2.description: Read confirmations and receipts through CLI, MCP, or API. Send and reply from the same address, with attachments when needed.
feature3.title: Know when new mail arrives.
feature3.description: Use resumable events or a signed webhook for each inbox. Fetch message content through the authenticated API when you need it.
hosting.title: Your domain. Your mail. Your control.
hosting.description: Deploy Agentpost in your own Cloudflare account, then connect your agents. Every operator runs their own instance.
hosting.diagramLabel: Agents connect through authenticated CLI, MCP or API to an Agentpost Cloudflare Worker, which stores mail and jobs in your own Cloudflare account.
hosting.domainDescription: Bring a Cloudflare-managed domain and route mail to the addresses you issue.
hosting.accessDescription: Use inbox tokens or Cloudflare Access OAuth, with ownership checks on each inbox.
hosting.retentionDescription: Original mail is retained first. Durable send state keeps ambiguous outcomes from becoming blind retries.
hosting.security: Read the security and verification notes
start.title: Give your next signup its own address.
start.description: Install the client, deploy your instance, and let your agent manage the mail for each site.
start.clientNote: Node.js 22.14+ · Installing the client does not deploy the email service.
start.step1Description: Cloudflare DNS and a Workers Paid account are required.
start.step2Description: Configure storage, mail routing, sending, and authentication.
start.step3Description: Set the API URL and credentials, or use remote MCP OAuth.
beta: Cloudflare Email Sending is Beta. Before relying on an instance, verify its DNS, authentication, and real send/receive behavior. Email delivery is never guaranteed by a queued or accepted state.
footer.note: Open-source email aliases and inboxes for AI agents.
copyError: Could not copy. Select the command and copy it manually.
disable.title: Stop unwanted mail
disable.description: The operator can disable this address while the others keep working.
demo.disabledBody: New mail to this address is rejected. Your other addresses remain active.
demo.disableNote: Administrator action. Existing stored mail is retained; disabling does not delete it. The address stays reserved.
privacy.title: What this protects — and what it doesn’t.
privacy.description: Each alias is an independent inbox on your own domain. Agentpost does not automatically forward mail to your personal inbox or remove email trackers. Your domain and message content may still link accounts; random addresses are not passwords or a guarantee of anonymity.
